messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT alert: Increased 5xx rate and elevated p95 latency observed for Hosted API and several Dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Source indicates upstream AWS STS/KMS throttling + ELB 5xx spikes. Auto-runbooks triggered: https://status.redwood.example/runbooks/dep-fanout (incident id: I-20260315-eu1)

Maria (oncall): acked. paging oncall. I'm pulling logs and tracing now.

Maria (oncall): @Ajay can you confirm if this is limited to eu-west-1 or also impacting cross-region controlplane calls?

Ajay (infra): seeing STS latencies and increased 500s from edge ELBs in eu-west-1 only. Controlplane calls from other regions (us-west-2, eu-west-2) look fine. Likely regional AWS dependency degradation.

Kevin (sre): adding heartbeat: routing fallback policy is configured but we need to manually promote fallback for Dedicated pools to avoid queuing. I'll start the temporary routing rule to prefer eu-west-2 for new sessions.

Maria (oncall): runbook step 2: enable model fallback + region preference. Kevin, can you paste commands you run?

Kevin (sre): running the routing change now. command:

```
# promote eu-west-2 as primary for new sessions in Hosted + Dedicated eu-west-1 pools
redwoodctl route update --scope hosted,dedicated --from-region eu-west-1 --to-region eu-west-2 --mode prefer --session-type new
```

Kevin (sre): also enabling model-variant fallback for large-generation models to reduce pressure on heavy-CPU hosts:

```
redwoodctl models rollout --selector "region:eu-west-1" --fallback-variant quantized-v1 --force
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job 7642 started: routing-change (initiated by Kevin).

Ajay (infra): starting capacity spin-up in eu-west-2 dedicated pool (estimate ~7m to be actionable).

Maria (oncall): Lena, can you draft a quick heads-up for affected customers (eu-west region) that we're seeing degraded latency/5xx and we are routing traffic to other regions to mitigate? Keep it short and non-alarming.

Lena (support): working on message. Draft: "We are currently experiencing elevated latency and 5xx errors for API requests routed to eu-west-1 due to an upstream cloud provider incident. We are actively failing over traffic to alternate regions to reduce impact. No action required from customers; we'll update as we learn more." Want me to post to status?

Maria (oncall): yes, post to status page after I approve. Include potential impact to Dedicated reserved pools (some capacity increases may be delayed while we scale in fallback region).

PagerDuty: Pager duty note: escalation to SRE manager if not mitigated by 20m.

Kevin (sre): routing-change applied. quick check of proxy logs shows lower request queueing locally. sample tail:

```
[2026-03-15T14:10:02Z] proxy eu-west-1 -> 503 x 12
[2026-03-15T14:10:12Z] proxy eu-west-1 -> 502 x 8
[2026-03-15T14:10:30Z] routing: new sessions -> eu-west-2 (pref)
[2026-03-15T14:11:01Z] proxy eu-west-1 5xx rate down 70% for new sessions
```

Maria (oncall): good. Ajay, how's eu-west-2 capacity?

Ajay (infra): autoscaler bumped Dedicated pool in eu-west-2 by +3 nodes, warmup in progress. Seeing expected healthy GPUs. Monitoring shows request drop in eu-west-1 by ~65% and corresponding increase in eu-west-2.

Lena (support): status page updated (draft posted): https://status.redwood.example/incidents/I-20260315-eu1. Customers notified.

Maria (oncall): tracking customer impact: support queue shows 6 open tickets from EU customers (mostly timeouts/5xx). Adding severity note: S3 uploads via hosted connectors also impacted — potential dependency on KMS calls.

Kevin (sre): investigating KMS/STS logs, there's a clear increase in error responses from AWS iam/sts and kms in eu-west-1 region. Example call trace:

```
- sts:GetCallerIdentity -> 429 throttling (backoff)
- kms:Decrypt -> 500 gateway error
```

Maria (oncall): ok. Mitigation plan summary: 1) prefer eu-west-2 for new sessions and Dedicated new allocations; 2) enable model fallback to quantized variants; 3) temporarily increase rate-limits for existing critical customers to avoid token timeouts where safe; 4) support communications posted.

Ajay (infra): started a targeted exception for a few enterprise tenants to allow higher concurrency on eu-west-2 while we monitor. Note: watch billing/quotas.

Kevin (sre): adding a short-term cache bypass for auth calls where safe to reduce STS pressure (memo: only for non-sensitive flows). Pushing a config:

```
auth.cache.enabled=false --selector region:eu-west-1,flow:non-sensitive
```

Maria (oncall): 25 minutes in. Still seeing residual 5xx from eu-west-1 but overall service error rate down 60% and user-facing latency improved for rerouted sessions. PagerDuty still open.

PagerDuty: Reminder: escalate if not fully resolved by 14:30Z.

Maria (oncall): handoff incoming in 15m to Kevin (next on-call). I'll summarize current state for handoff.

Maria (oncall): HANDOFF: I-20260315-eu1 - Root cause: external AWS region degradation (STS/KMS/ELB). Mitigations applied: routing pref to eu-west-2 for new sessions, Dedicated scale-up in eu-west-2, model fallback to quantized variants, temporary auth-cache bypass for non-sensitive flows, targeted tenant concurrency exceptions. Current status: error rates decreasing but eu-west-1 still showing elevated 5xx for legacy sessions. Support tickets: 6 open, customers notified via status. Next actions for next oncall: monitor metrics (5xx rate, p95), confirm AWS console updates, liaise with AWS support if not recovering by 30m.

Kevin (sre): taking over. I'll keep an eye and coordinate with Ajay for capacity. Assigning myself to escalate to AWS account team if no recovery in 30m.

deploy-bot: Deploy job 7642 succeeded: routing-change applied.

Ajay (infra): healthcheck: eu-west-2 Dedicated pool CPU/GPU temps normal, request handling stable.

Kevin (sre): verifying user-facing metrics: hosted API p95 (eu-west-1) has dropped from 2.9s to 1.1s average for new sessions after routing change. 5xx rate for Hosted overall down by 48% vs peak.

Maria (oncall): thanks team. I'll mark this thread as monitored and update if anything changes. If we see reversion of traffic back to eu-west-1, we should do a controlled canary.

Kevin (sre): agreed. I'll prepare a canary plan for re-enable: small % traffic back for 10m then observe error/latency.

Lena (support): I'll keep customers updated every 30m until resolved.

opsbot: INCIDENT update: mitigations applied; impact reduced. Continue monitoring.

Kevin (sre): 40m since start; holding. Will escalate to AWS if we see plateau.

Maria (oncall): closing initial pager but leaving incident open for follow-up and RCA.

PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged closed by Maria.

Kevin (sre): final note before a write-up: capture configuration diffs and timings for playbook. I'll collect logs and raise RCA ticket after full resolution.

Lena (support): Support notes attached to incident ticket.

opsbot: INCIDENT I-20260315-eu1 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Further updates will be posted to the incident page.
